description: This Java class defines a settings activity for a Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine in an Android application. It extends PreferenceActivity to provide a preferences UI, loading headers from a resource.

classes.name: RobotSpeakSettings
classes.description: An Android PreferenceActivity that loads and displays settings headers from a resource file for the TTS engine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity by calling the superclass implementation with the saved instance state.

methods.name: onBuildHeaders
methods.description: Loads headers for the preferences screen from an XML resource into the target list.
